legal.title: 📋 Legal notice & GDPR
legal.controller: Filenymous is open-source software. Files travel directly from one browser to the other (WebRTC) and are never stored by the publisher: there is no file database. Each user remains responsible for the files they share.
legal.data: To connect the two browsers, a signaling server temporarily exchanges the transfer code and network connection details (IP addresses, WebRTC parameters). When a direct connection is impossible, a TURN relay forwards the already-encrypted bytes (AES-256-GCM) without being able to read or keep them. Nothing is persisted. The browser and OS name (e.g. “Chrome · Windows”) is exchanged only between the two peers. No cookies, no analytics, no ads.
legal.erasure: Since nothing is stored on a server, there is nothing to erase on the publisher’s side: closing the sender’s tab ends the share and makes the link useless. The decryption key only exists inside the shared link.
legal.hosting: The site is hosted by OVHcloud (France). The signaling and TURN relay servers run on an OVHcloud VPS in Europe; they never see file contents.
